---
title: Clear Read/Write on world meshes no runtime script reads
topic: performance
tags: [isReadable, mesh memory, Read/Write]
summary: Meshes saved with isReadable keep a CPU copy at runtime; clearing it (m_IsReadable) on 13 world-owned meshes saved ~25.5 MB.
---
**Symptom:** world-owned meshes generated by editor scripts (box-UV2 copies, merged seats) were saved readable; the
heaviest single mesh was 12.8 MB for 101,802 tris.

**Fix / rule:** clear `m_IsReadable` (SerializedObject on the mesh asset) on every world mesh no Udon or runtime script
reads: ~25.5 MB across 13 meshes. Keep it on for meshes a runtime script reads.

**Verify:** the meshes still render (same-camera capture) and the bundle or memory figure drops.
